    • findAllMetadataOrderByIdAsc

      @Query("SELECT l.idInstrumentLogo AS idInstrumentLogo, l.isin AS isin, l.name AS name, l.logoScope AS logoScope,\n l.assetPath AS assetPath, l.contentSha256 AS contentSha256, l.namePatterns AS namePatterns,\n l.hosts AS hosts, l.hostSuffixes AS hostSuffixes, l.createdBy AS createdBy,\n CASE WHEN l.svgContent IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS hasSvgContent\nFROM InstrumentLogo l ORDER BY l.idInstrumentLogo ASC") List<InstrumentLogoJpaRepository.InstrumentLogoMetadataProjection> findAllMetadataOrderByIdAsc()
      Loads lightweight catalog metadata for every InstrumentLogo row without reading the potentially large svg_content CLOB, ordered deterministically by primary key so issuer host matching preserves catalog order.
